Chapter 704: Chapter 10 The First Type of Second Realm Fusion Rules (Subscribe Please)_2

The essence of the Life and Death Samsara Rule within the Guiding Space manifested, making it slightly easier for the later generations to comprehend this type of Fusion Rules.

Some bottlenecks that had trapped Evolvers for ten thousand years could now be broken in seven to eight thousand years.

It just became a bit easier.

Not that the difficulty was directly reduced to zero.

Even so, such Guiding Spaces made countless Tenth Rank Lives fervent. At critical moments, being slightly easier constitutes a qualitative difference, not to mention a bit easier.

For instance, discerning the Pillar-level Fusion Rules of the Second Realm just a bit earlier could allow one to break through to Eleventh Rank before their lifespan limit.

...

This was not only the gap between Eleventh Rank and Tenth Rank but also the difference between life and death.

However.

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s performance caused the man in the black robe a bit of confusion.

Because over the past fifty years, Lin Yuan had steadily understood other Pillar-level Fusion Rules, sending out incarnations to comprehend them within the Guiding Spaces of other doors.

That is to say, over a span of fifty years, the time Lin Yuan actually spent on the Life and Death Samsara Rule was, arguably, only a portion.

“Do the lives outside nowadays all disregard reason to such an extent?”

The man in the black robe stayed silent for a long time, suddenly harboring this thought in his mind.

His memory was significantly lacking, but he vaguely remembered that Lin Yuan’s speed of comprehension was exaggeratedly terrifying.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

“I can now… attempt to strive for Tier 11.” Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

The biggest threshold from Tenth Rank to Eleventh Rank is to elevate a Pillar-level Rule to the Second Realm.

In addition, there are other requirements regarding the Physical Soul, Inner World, and so on, but with Lin Yuan’s accumulated foundation, naturally all are satisfied.

That is to say.

If Lin Yuan wished to strive for Eleventh Rank, he could step into the Eleventh Rank.

From just entering Tenth Rank to stepping into Eleventh Rank, it only took fifty years.

If this were to be spread, it would definitely drive a group of Tenth Rank Lives insane, and even Eleventh Rank Lives would hardly believe it.

The leap from Tenth Rank to Eleventh Rank is a cross of a Great Realm, a leap in the essence of life. There exist Tenth Rank Lives who have stayed at this realm for millions of years or even tens of millions of years.

And you used just fifty years?

“Still, there’s no rush.”

“I currently only occupy six out of the twelve Guiding Spaces in the depths of the twelve gates on the dark planet.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, suppressing the urge to break through to Eleventh Rank.

The main reason is that there’s no significant benefit.

Currently, Lin Yuan is under no pressure, Human Civilization is exceedingly strong, and he can certainly break through to Eleventh Rank a bit later.

Because once he breaks through to Eleventh Rank, he won’t be able to enter the remaining six gates on the dark planet.

The dark Life Planet is a star of Tenth Rank Heritage, allowing only Tenth Rank Lives to enter; neither Ninth Rank nor Eleventh Rank may go in.

Therefore—

The most correct action for Lin Yuan is to discern all the Fusion Rules corresponding to the twelve gates on the dark planet and then send out incarnations into the Guiding Spaces.

He should secure the slots for enlightenment first.

As long as the incarnations occupy the Guiding Spaces, even if Lin Yuan breaks through to Eleventh Rank, he won’t be expelled.

And at Tenth Rank, the more Fusion Rules one comprehends and the higher the level of cultivation of the Fusion Rules, the greater the benefit to oneself.

From any perspective, there’s no reason for Lin Yuan to rush into Eleventh Rank desperately.

Other Peak Tenth Rank Powerhouses, after elevating a Pillar-level Fusion Rule to the Second Realm, would hesitate no more to strive for Eleventh Rank.

It’s because their potential at Tenth Rank is already exhausted, and there’s no point in delaying any longer.

But Lin Yuan is different; he still has plenty of room for improvement.

…

“In fifty years, apart from the Life and Death Samsara Rule and the Great Destruction Rule, I’ve also comprehended four other Pillar-level Rules, which correspond to the Pillar-level Rules of those twelve gates on the dark planet.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the Pillar-level Fusion Rules are far more than just twelve.

However, knowing the effects of the Guiding Spaces behind the twelve gates of the dark planet, Lin Yuan naturally focused on those twelve Pillar-level Rules in his comprehension of the Pillar-level Fusion Rules.

“The six Pillar-level Fusion Rules I’ve discerned so far are the relatively simple ones, involving the fusion between two Pillar Rules.”

“The remaining six Pillar-level Fusion Rules are much more difficult, encompassing the fusion of three, four, or even five Pillar Rules.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Even within Pillar-level Fusion Rules, there naturally exists a hierarchy.

Leaving aside the inherent attributes of the Pillar Rules themselves, just the number of Pillar Rules involved in the fusion also absolutely determines the height of the final Fusion Rule.

Incorporating Space, Life, and Destruction as three Pillar-level Fusion Rules naturally makes it stronger than just Space and Life Pillar-level Fusion Rules.

“Take it slowly.”

“I have plenty of time.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Tenth Rank Evolvers can easily live for hundreds of millions of years; he’s hardly at that point yet.

…

“To fuse the Time Rule with the Space Rules, both being Pillar-level Fusion Rules…” Lin Yuan thought about his own attempts in the domain of space-time over the years.

Though the Rule of Time is also a Pillar-level Rule, it reigns supreme over other Pillar-level Rules, aiming to fuse space-time? Up to now, Lin Yuan’s progress in this area can be said to be slow.

With the might of the Rule of Time, even fusing it with an ordinary rule would be much stronger than usual Pillar-level Fusion Rules.

“Fusing space-time and then elevating the Space-Time Rule to the Fifth Realm—that is one of the thresholds for Eleventh Rank Powerhouses to strive for the Ultimate.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts spread out. At his level, he was privy to information that was once incredibly secret, including intelligence on the Eleventh Rank Strive for the Ultimate.
